entries.title: What Housebets is
entries.text: Housebets is a crypto casino and sportsbook at housebets.com. Provably fair House Games, slots from other providers, live casino, and sports betting. 24/7 support.

entries.title: House Games list
entries.text: House Games are made by Housebets: Dice, Mines, Plinko, Keno, Wheel, Limbo, Max Win, Dragon Tower, Hilo, Blackjack, and Hubie's Road. Chat crash maps to Limbo. There is no Crash lobby card.

entries.title: Provably fair
entries.text: House Games are provably fair. Each result can be checked with the seeds shown in the game. Third-party games use licensed providers with certified RNG and published RTP. Hilo's table shows RTP 99.00%.

entries.title: This stream
entries.text: This Kick stream promotes Housebets House Games. Stake is locked at 0 by the host. It is a demo show, not a deposit pitch. 18 plus. Gamble responsibly.

entries.title: Dice
entries.text: Dice: set a target, then Bet. Over and Under are mode chips, not the play button. This stream bets 0.

entries.title: Mines
entries.text: Mines: Bet, then pick tiles. A mine ends the round. Random pick exists on some boards. Stake stays 0 on this stream.

entries.title: Keno
entries.text: Keno: Classic, Low, Medium, High are risk chips. Pick numbers or Auto pick, then Bet. It is not Hilo Higher or Lower.

entries.title: Hilo
entries.text: Hilo: guess the next card Higher or same, Lower or same, Skip, or Same, then Bet. Table shows RTP 99.00%.

entries.title: Blackjack
entries.text: Blackjack: Bet first. Hit and Stand appear after the deal. Boxes 1, 2, 3 are table options, not a second game.

entries.title: Dragon Tower
entries.text: Dragon Tower: Bet, then climb with tiles or Random pick. Cash out only after a climb, not as the first click.

entries.title: Hubie's Road
entries.text: Hubie's Road is a House Game. Start with GO or Bet. The lobby card is under House Games, not always on the top grid.

entries.title: Limbo
entries.text: Limbo: set a target multiplier, then Bet. Chat asking for crash is played as Limbo.

entries.title: Plinko
entries.text: Plinko: drop a ball through pegs. Bet starts the drop. Risk chips change the board, they are not the play button.

entries.title: Wheel
entries.text: Wheel: Bet or Spin the Housebets wheel. Segments pay by the printed multipliers. This stream stays at stake 0.

entries.title: Max Win
entries.text: Max Win is a House Game. Bet starts the round. Do not invent a jackpot number that is not on screen.

entries.title: Chat requests
entries.text: One viewer asking for a House Game switches now. Several requests play in order, a few minutes each. Say the name and the game. Do not say queued.
